title: Made an engine to build dense microvoxel games with AI
author: Donkeytonk
selftext:
We've been building virtual matter for a while and we recently made a big update to support MCP building direct from claude, codex etc. 

All the objects you see in the world are built and rendered as microvoxels generated from AI, a kind of generative microvoxel engine. 

* **Everything is made of microvoxels and fully destructible.** Objects are solid layered volumes you can cut, carve and repaint. I have another demo where I use a shotgun that can strip a beasts flesh layer by layer and leave its skeleton standing, will share that too if there's interest.
* **Built for AI coding agents.** Through a CLI and MCP server, an agent like Claude Code can push scripts, run code live, read errors and playtest its own work.
* **Multiplayer by default.** Every world is a shared server, scripted in Lua on both the server and each player’s machine.
* **Streams to the browser,** nothing to install. 
* **Prompt-to-world and remixing.** Build a world from a prompt or remix someone else’s, then keep going with your own agent.

The demo shown here carving up pumpkins was made with one of our recent supporters Cliff Bleszinski (ex-Unreal / Gears of War). You can try the demo here: [https://play.virtualmatter.ai/p/pumpkin-party-ibd5j8ot](https://play.virtualmatter.ai/p/pumpkin-party-ibd5j8ot)
